en:
Rai: Stopping here? A wise decision.
Long operations are bad for your health.
Rest well, then rejoin the operation.

Noriko: Huh? You're stopping here? Aww,
just when it was getting good...

Kazumi: Noriko...
Everyone has their own circumstances.

Noriko: I see... Yeah, you're right.
Then, same time next time...
I-NA-ZU-MA KIIICK!!

Fitzcarraldo: Well, well... How lucky
you are, to meet me here.
Fitzcarraldo: What? You have something else to do?

Fitzcarraldo: Then shall I lend a hand?
Mind you, I cut everything in two.

Shu: Oh? You're suspending the game?
A pity after coming so far, but so be it...
Then let us lower the curtain for a while.

Masaki: Huh? You're quitting already?
C'mon, that's giving up way too fast. One
Cyflash would wipe out small fry like these!

Ryusei: Y-You're quitting here?
I see... That's a shame.

Ryusei: I... want to fight someone stronger!
...Wait, that's not my line.
Ryusei: Oh, taking a break here?

Ryusei: Then I'll spend the time playing "Super Robot
Wars Complete Box", on sale now!

Ryusei: Thanks for playing this far! If you
like, try "Super Hero Operations" too.
I'm in it!

Ryusei: See you next week!!
...Wait, this isn't a TV show.

Aya: Oh? Stopping here? Of course, not everyone can
play Robot Wars three days and nights straight like Ryu.
Aya: Well then, see you again!

Heero: You intend to suspend the mission...?
Then don't forget this.

Heero: Even while you're gone, our battle continues...
So make sure you return to the mission.

Koji: Alright, that's that!
Take it easy for a while! But come back
and keep playing as soon as you can!

Koji: I'll be waiting!
Same time next time! Mazin, Go!!

Banjo: Good work. You did well.
Get some rest.
But I'd like you to resume soon.

Banjo: Don't forget, our fate rests in
your hands. Until your next session...
Come heeeeeere!!

Lune: What!? Suspend the game!?
Give me a break!! ...is what I'd say,
but I guess you've got your own stuff...

Lune: Well, can't be helped.
But hurry up and come back.

Lune: I won't be satisfied until
we settle this once and for all!

Shinji: Oh... You're stopping? Ah, no, it's
fine, I mean... sorry.

Shinji: I just thought... maybe you'd play
a little longer. Well, see you.

Scirocco: Suspending the game after coming this far...
Expecting dignity from people is hopeless, then.

Scirocco: Indeed, people must be guided.
They need an absolute ruler to lead them...
